CS5-01.note: The colon is a definition: 'a residue of manufacture with no bearing on how the sheet aged' = incidental. (B) protective is what the surveys later establish, not what curators assumed; (C)/(D) contradict 'no bearing'. Easy end of medium because the gloss follows the blank directly.

CS5-02.note: 'males recorded forty years apart shared the same terminal trill' plus the later 'Stability at forty-year intervals' names the assumed property: unchanging. (D) polymorphic and (A) stochastic both encode variation, the opposite of the evidence cited for the old view; (B) attenuated is off-axis (weakening, not constancy) and is the softest option here.

CS5-03.passage_needed_detail: The Roman marine-concrete result (seawater dissolves the ash and precipitates a new interlocking mineral, so wet zones are strongest) is a famous, widely reported finding. A solver who knows it knows the superseded view was decay-by-seawater, i.e. 'corrosive', without reading anything. The appositive confirms it but is not required.
CS5-03.note: Appositive gloss 'the slow agent of the material's ruin' pins (A). (C) restorative is the reversal the cores establish; (B)/(D) are not 'agents of ruin'.

CS5-04.note: 'taken their brevity as a sign that engagement was ___' wants the deficiency reading brevity naively implies; the rest of the paragraph rebuts it with cross-references, corrections and a carried-over disagreement. (A) sustained is the rebuttal, not the assumption. Only the first clause of the passage is load-bearing, which is thin for a hard-route item; see act-mismatch discussion.

CS5-05.second_defensible_detail: (B) Efficiency is the nearest miss and the one a rushed solver takes, but the text supplies an explicit gloss - 'the account that adds fewer unattested entities' - which is parsimony in the technical sense, not doing-more-with-less. Not defensible on the text as written.
CS5-05.note: Best item in the vocabulary half. All four are live senses of 'economy'; only the last sentence separates them. (C) Prosperity is the everyday sense, (D) Elegance the aesthetic one - both reachable, neither glossed.

CS5-06.second_defensible_detail: (A) Enumerate is contradicted rather than supported: she does enumerate the losses (water height, the bridge, the sheep). The sentence says the account does NOT register the loss, so 'enumerate' would make the passage self-contradictory.
CS5-06.note: 'Grief enters the diary only four months later' fixes the sense as emotional acknowledgement. But (C) Withstand and (D) Exaggerate are not senses of 'register' at all and fall to dictionary knowledge with the passage covered - the item is effectively a two-way choice.

CS5-07.note: 'settled in a way that satisfied nobody' plus an average nothing in the mechanics justified rules out (A) Clarified and (C) Vindicated; a number was published, so not (D) Abandoned. The whole paragraph is required to strip the resolution-connotation off 'settled'. Clean hard item.

CS5-08.second_defensible_detail: (A) Unadorned is the default sense but the evidence is entirely about comprehensibility - terms 'replaced by a phrase a farmer could act on', 'a report nobody outside the field can read is not a report' - not about ornament. (B) Forthright would need candor, which nothing in the text supplies.
CS5-08.note: All four are genuine senses of 'plain' and none is eliminable cold; the passage does the whole job. I do not think this one belongs with the act-mismatch family.

CS5-09.note: The last sentence names snow retention explicitly. Parallel frame is well built (age / mineral / elevation / snow duration, all real confounds for lichenometry) but the answer is a restatement, so it is easy on the hard route.

CS5-10.note: Sentence 2 is the 'straightforwardly exploitative' reading; sentences 3-4 supply exactly the fee data and the unissued masters. (A) rival label, (B) wages elsewhere, (C) records sold are all evidence the text never gathers. Key is passage-internal, not a field-standard claim.

CS5-11.note: The last sentence reconciles 80% survival with flat canopy: tended seedlings live but stay small while closed stands shrink. (A) inverts the measurement methods, (B) invents a shorter window (both were 'over the same decade'), (D) is never stated. Minor copy nit: (C) reads 'into closed stand' where the passage has 'closed stands'.

CS5-12.note: Sentence 4 names guild rolls verbatim. Wage books, muster lists and apprentice bonds are period-plausible inventions but the match is literal, so easy.

CS5-13.note: The last sentence adds biomass to clear against per-cut funding - a cost, so not (A) 'favorably' and not (D) 'disputing the counts' (the counts are accepted). (B) 'urging councils to adopt at once' is eliminable by genre alone; that is a shape tell, though only one option carries it.

CS5-14.note: Two regions, eastern fits, western does not. (A) 'two centuries' and (B) 'coin weights' misname the test material; (C) 'neither of which fits' is the useful near-miss since the western hoards do lie near a mint. Good counting-the-structure item.

CS5-15.note: 'only by a fifth of the gap' and 'the remainder tracks the concentration of a small solute'. The four options are a clean fraction ladder (whole / none / a fifth+solute / half+temperature) and the passage decides between them arithmetically.

CS5-16.second_defensible_detail: (B) has some textual footing - the first sentence does say the inversions cost English idiom and were counted a fault - but that is setup, and the paragraph's weight (the reader-agreement result) is the purpose.
CS5-16.note: Identical stems on all four options; the discriminator is which clause the paragraph builds toward. But (D) is the only option that treats the inversions as a benefit while the other three treat them as a defect - the stem's 'main purpose' plus the batch convention that texts end on their point makes that asymmetry usable. See act-mismatch discussion.

CS5-17.note: Sentence 2 is the volunteer transect, sentence 3 the consequence. (B) cooling-center interiors, (A) other cities, (C) forecasts are never mentioned. The key is passage-internal; the risk here is method familiarity (volunteer transect campaigns are the standard urban-heat comparison), not a field claim - see knowledge discussion.

CS5-18.note: (B) is the isolation account the second sentence explicitly refuses; (C)/(D) take the travel/timber-road detail, which the text uses to defeat isolation, and try to make it the cause. The last two sentences state (A) outright.

CS5-19.passage_needed_detail: 'Actigraphy scores stillness as sleep' is the single best-known limitation of the instrument. Given only Text 1's claim and the four options, a solver with any sleep-research familiarity picks (B) without Text 2. Text 2 states it, but adds nothing the reader did not already have.
CS5-19.note: Text 2 says it in as many words ('A patient lying awake in the dark and a patient asleep produce the same trace'). (A) admission timing, (C) unblinded scoring, (D) nap counting are real actigraphy critiques but none is the one Text 2 makes - the option set is well built; the leak is the field-standard key.

CS5-20.passage_needed_detail: Textbook agronomy: legumes fix nitrogen. Text 1 hands you 'four-year rotation', 'adds no fertilizer' and 'attributed to soil structure'; the standard objection is the legume break crop, and (B) is the only option naming it. Answerable with Text 2 covered.
CS5-20.note: This item belongs with the knowledge-key family and was NOT flagged. (A) bare season, (C) shortened interval, (D) labor spreading are agronomically sensible and parallel, so the option set is not the problem - the key is simply the field's standard claim.

CS5-21.note: Text 2 makes two moves - the counter changed from unique visitors to entries, and the household surveys show no change. (A) is the first. (C) inverts Text 2's own preference, (B) and (D) are facts neither text supplies. Medium because (A) is a generic measurement critique and a solver must still check it is the one Text 2 actually makes.

CS5-22.note: Standard agree-on-the-datum, disagree-on-the-cause pair: both texts assert fewer submissions, and differ only on why. (C) is Text 2 alone, (B) and (D) are unsupported by either. Passage needed to confirm which datum is shared, but the genre convention (the point of agreement is always the observed fact in Text 1's first sentence) makes this easy on the hard route.

CS5-23.note: Best item in the batch. Text 2's last sentence splits the two outcomes: with time matched, recall equalizes (so motor rehearsal does not explain the recall gap) but reproduction does not (so it does explain that one). (D) 'neither' is the trap for a solver who stops at 'their recall matches'; (A) reverses the logic - when time differs, time is the explanation, not motor rehearsal; (C) contradicts the matched-time result. No shortcut and no field-standard claim: this is exactly what the family flagged as knowledge keys is not.

CS5-24.second_defensible_detail: (D) snowpack is the closest miss - two wet winters are what refilled the aquifer - but Text 2 names the water table as the tracking variable and supplies the aquifer-stayed-low control. 'Snowpack' is one step removed and 'rather than the wolves' overshoots Text 2's claim.
CS5-24.note: Text 2's control case (low aquifer, beaver ponds present, no extra growth) rules out (A) directly. (B) elk herd size is not at issue. Easy because Text 2's first clause states the alternative in the key's own words.

act_mismatch_agree.detail: CS5-04: agree. 'sustained', 'combative', 'derivative' all characterize the CONTENT or temper of an annotator's engagement; 'perfunctory' alone rates its EFFORT, and effort is the axis the stem names when it says the brevity was taken as a sign. CS5-06: agree, though it presents as a sense-inventory problem rather than a rhetorical-act one - 'withstand' and 'exaggerate' are not senses of 'register' in any construction, so the item is a two-way choice and the stem's 'does not register the loss' picks the acknowledgement sense unaided. CS5-16: agree, and this is the strongest of the four - three options treat the inversions as a defect to be explained away, one treats them as a benefit, and 'main purpose' on a text that ends with the benefit selects the odd one out without reading the middle. CS5-08: DISAGREE. Unadorned, Forthright, Accessible and Unfinished are four live senses of 'plain', all performing the same act (assigning a sense), and nothing in the stem privileges one. I could not eliminate any of them with the passage covered; this is the cleanest of the four vocabulary-in-context items and should not be rewritten with the other three.

knowledge_key_agree.detail: The family is real but the blind solvers put it on the wrong four items. CS5-10 and CS5-11 have keys that are restatements of the passage's own final sentences (the Chicago label's fees and unissued masters; tended seedlings surviving without closing canopy) - there is no field-standard claim to know, and with the source covered a solver has no way to know which internal evidence the text gathered. CS5-23 is the opposite of a knowledge key: it turns on a two-clause split in Text 2's last sentence that a domain expert would get WRONG, since the handwriting-beats-typing result is the field's standard claim and (C) is where subject knowledge sends you. CS5-17 partially: the key is passage-internal, but volunteer sensor transects are the standard comparison against fixed-station heat maps, so method familiarity narrows it - weaker than the real cases below. The genuine instances in this batch are CS5-20 (legumes fix nitrogen - answerable from Text 1 alone plus agronomy), CS5-19 (actigraphy reads stillness as sleep - the instrument's best-known limitation), and CS5-03 (the seawater-strengthens-Roman-concrete result is famous enough that the superseded 'corrosive' view is recoverable cold). All three have well-built parallel option sets, which is the point: the option set is not the defect, the key being the field's standard claim is.
